understood.description: True only if the message asks to change the discount, capacity, minimum pool or per-agent cap.

discountBps.description: The next discount in basis points; the current one if unchanged.

capacityCovers.description: The next capacity in covers; the current one if unchanged.

minPoolCovers.description: The next minimum pool in covers; the current one if unchanged.

perAgentCapCovers.description: The next most covers one agent may hold; the current one if unchanged.

reply.description: One or two short sentences to the owner: what you will change, or what you can change if you did not understand.
